name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight grounded and even, shoulders squared to the camera, chin level, a focused and steady gaze — a disciplined, battle-ready stance, his expression resolute and warm, a faint righteous confidence in his eyes.
effects: Soft motes of golden light drift gently around him, faint radiant warmth emanating from his armor.

components.companion: his bonded Angel, a radiant winged figure in gleaming armor, hovering just behind him, wings spread wide

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the tank-group default wardrobe set + the existing moonlit-terrace background.
